name: dev-AI-plugins
description: Reusable skills, rules, commands, and agents for Claude Code and Cursor.

plugins.name: base-dev-kit
plugins.description: Honesty and security rules always applied, plus on-demand skills for clean code, git workflow, test-driven development, dependency management, and documentation — applicable to any language or stack.

plugins.name: frontend-dev-kit
plugins.description: Rules, skills, and MCP servers for React 19 Feature-Sliced Design apps: TypeScript, shadcn/ui, Tailwind, react-query, react-hook-form + zod, react-i18next, and Vitest.

plugins.name: node-backend-dev-kit
plugins.description: Rules, skills, and MCP servers for layered Node.js 22 + Express 5 + TypeScript APIs (routes → controllers → services → repositories): Zod 4, Drizzle on PostgreSQL, JWT + RBAC, RFC 9457 errors, pino, resilience, OpenAPI, Docker, and Vitest + Testcontainers. Reference implementation: backend-boilerplate.

plugins.name: node-agent-dev-kit
plugins.description: Rules, skills, and MCP servers for TypeScript AI agent services on Express 5 with LangGraph.js + LangChain.js: state graphs, tools, OpenRouter models with fallbacks, Postgres checkpoints, human-in-the-loop, multi-agent, pgvector hybrid RAG, guardrails, SSE streaming, and evals. Requires node-backend-dev-kit. Reference implementation: agent-boilerplate.

plugins.name: pptx-dev-kit
plugins.description: Create a 16:9 PowerPoint from a brief via a checked-in layout engine, or edit an existing .pptx in place via OOXML — design schema, outline, deck.json render, and structural validation.

plugins.name: agent-dev-kit
plugins.description: Rules, skills, and agents for building production TypeScript/Node AI agents with the OpenAI SDK via OpenRouter, @openai/agents or LangGraph.js, and RAG pipelines with hybrid search and reranking.

plugins.name: backend-dev-kit
plugins.description: Rules, skills, and agents for building production Node.js backends with Express 5, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, Zod, and Vitest.

plugins.name: spec-dev-kit
plugins.description: Multi-agent pipeline that turns raw requirements in .spec/context/ into a validated, human-approved hybrid YAML+Markdown spec — requirements register with coverage, roles, permissions, rules, state machines, and a step-by-step delivery plan with per-slice build briefs — read by html-generator-kit, feature-dev-kit, backend-dev-kit, agent-dev-kit, and both orchestrators.

plugins.name: html-generator-kit
plugins.description: Turns a validated spec-dev-kit spec into a clickable Alpine.js multi-page HTML prototype (CDN-free for styling; Alpine and Google Fonts load from a CDN). A provided theme, brand, style guide, mockup, or layout is binding; ui-ux-pro-max supplies the design direction only when none is provided. Headless-browser verified before the skill-owned review gate.

plugins.name: feature-dev-kit
plugins.description: Hub-and-spoke factory that builds one React Feature-Sliced Design feature per run (nested screen-tasks share the branch and commit) from a spec-dev-kit spec and optional html prototype, through architecture-audit, quality gates, and a skill-owned human review. Never opens a pull request.

plugins.name: frontend-orchestrator-kit
plugins.description: Frontend-only sequencer: spec-dev-kit to author a spec, html-generator-kit to prototype it, then feature-dev-kit once per feature (nested screen-tasks share that call) against a persisted, resumable checklist. Use app-orchestrator-kit /orchestrate-app for the full-stack dispatcher.

plugins.name: app-orchestrator-kit
plugins.description: Full-stack app dispatcher: analyzes an approved spec-dev-kit spec and optional html-generator-kit prototype, then runs backend-dev-kit, agent-dev-kit, and frontend-orchestrator-kit only when needed, against a persisted work-plan.

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: app-dev-kitv2 engine: /factory:* commands, a deterministic Conductor step protocol, file-based state in .factory/, gates, Loop Warden escalation, context packs, human notes and enforcement hooks. Stage, role and stack packs plug in through manifests.

plugins.name: factory-analysis
plugins.description: app-dev-kitv2 analysis stages S0–S4: intake, bootstrap or discovery, requirements (PRD or delta-spec), stories, architecture with API contract, and test-first planning. Eight agents from haiku to opus; needs the factory engine.

plugins.name: factory-role-frontend
plugins.description: app-dev-kitv2 frontend role: test author (red), builder (green) and sandboxed prototyper for React Feature-Sliced Design, gated by real test, typecheck, lint and build runs. Uses frontend-dev-kit; needs the factory engine.

plugins.name: factory-role-backend
plugins.description: app-dev-kitv2 backend role: test author (red), builder (green) and migration author for layered Express 5 + Zod + Drizzle services, with OpenAPI-conformance and migration-rollback checks. Uses node-backend-dev-kit; needs the factory engine.

plugins.name: factory-role-ai-agent
plugins.description: app-dev-kitv2 AI-agent role: architect, test author against a scripted model, LangGraph.js and RAG builders, and an eval author; model-facing tasks pass only with a real eval run. Uses node-agent-dev-kit; needs the factory engine.

plugins.name: factory-quality
plugins.description: app-dev-kitv2 quality stages: acceptance tests from the spec before implementation, a seven-lens review plus scripted role audits, and black-box QA by charters; failures become planner-made fix tasks. Needs the factory engine.

plugins.name: factory-delivery
plugins.description: app-dev-kitv2 delivery stages: living feature docs, a commit plan with task trailers and a PR body with a spec trace (shipped by the engine), and PR comment triage. Needs the factory engine.

plugins.name: factory-adapter-github
plugins.description: app-dev-kitv2 GitHub adapter: push, draft PR and review comments via the gh CLI; dry-run by default. Needs the factory engine.
